title: PA-CAT
blurb: The Physician Assistant College Admission Test: 240 multiple-choice questions drawn from nine prerequisite subjects (anatomy, physiology, general biology, biochemistry, general and organic chemistry, microbiology, behavioral sciences, genetics, statistics), delivered at Pearson VUE in a 4.5-hour appointment that includes pre-exam questions, a break between sections and a post-exam survey. Exam Master does not publish per-subject question counts, so the section weights below are this bank's own approximation; behavioral sciences is not yet covered here.
